text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? The entry form for the "Splash Rec"? 
I've certainly received yours. Go on and 
have a fun time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(T-Trainer, you work entirely too fast...! 
Ugh... Saying I want to cancel now would 
be...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(I can't say it... It would just be a 
repeat of what happened back then. 
I can't cause trouble for those around me 
any longer...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I-Is that so... 
Then I shall be sure to enjoy myself to 
the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—In the end, it turned out I had to 
participate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's fortunate that my schedule just 
happened to be open, but still... 
Goodness, Gold Ship-san is far too selfish 
for her own good.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that the truth. You won't find many 
out there 
who think the entire world revolves around 
them like she does.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...She's the exact polar opposite of how 
you are right now. 
Sheesh, little miss princess frets over 
the most pointless crap.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pointless...? Me? 
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, I am 
simply striving to discipline myself 
properly...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ha...! Yeah right, that's real noble of 
ya. 
Still, if I were in your shoes, I would've 
just asked to cancel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thinking you're the center of the universe 
is bad enough, but enduring everything 
'cause you're only worried about what the 
world thinks is pretty damn pointless too, 
don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...! But, still...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*, *exhale*... Being around the 
upperclassmen's classroom makes me so 
nervous. 
Hmmmm... Come forth, my courage! A-All 
right!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my~? If it isn't Chiyo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah! M-M-M-Maruzen-sa~n! 
That's bad for my heart~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, so sorry, so sorry! ♪ 
So? Did you need something from our class?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, today... I came to invite you to 
something! 
Um, have you heard of the "Splash Rec"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's part of the Summer Walk... And, well, 
I thought you might like resort spots, 
Maruzen-san, so I wondered if you'd like 
to go together... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The "Splash Rec"? Ah... I see.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is your schedule already booked by any 
chance? 
I'm so sorry for springing this on you out 
of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...No no, not at all! It's no problem 
whatsoever~~! 
Sounds totally groovy, doesn't it?! A 
resort vacation, wowee!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: R-Really? What a relief...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's put on some smashing swimsuits and 
make this a wicked cool summer! ☆ 
I'm super stoked! Woo-hoo~~! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Is Maruzen-san... really okay? 
She somehow seemed a bit different from 
usual...?)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear? Apparently 
Maruzen-senpai is participating in this 
year's "Splash Rec" too. They say it's her 
first time since the summer she enrolled~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
For real? I'm pretty sure she won that 
year, right? 
Talk about a crazy-strong Umamusume 
entering the fray! Guess I'll just 
spectate the finals then~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I see, that's Maruzen-san for you! 
Wait, huh? Does that mean she hasn't 
participated ever since... then...?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm...? I wonder if there's a reason...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And before anyone knew it, 
the day of the "Splash Rec" qualifiers had 
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOH! Here we go! 
Think you can keep up with my sick lure 
tech, huh?! WOOOOH?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan is all fired up, isn't she~? ♪ 
I'm gonna do my best today too! Yay, 
yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Do we need fishing rods for today's 
qualifiers? 
Oh no, what do I do? I didn't bring one~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We won't be using those, so please rest 
easy. 
The four qualifier events were written in 
the guide, were they not?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! 
Ehehe, I got so nervous that I panicked 
for a second.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, the events were "200m 
Freestyle", "Floating Island Race", 
"Tightrope Quiz", and "True 3000m 
Freestyle (Items Allowed)"...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Points are awarded based on your placing 
in each event, and the top eight advance 
to the finals. 
Mind, technique, and body—everything will 
be tested. It's bound to get pretty 
heated...

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
—And so, we kick things off with the 200m 
Freestyle! 
Everyone, please gather by the poolside!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, McQueen. Look at that sour 
look on your face~ 
You still pouting?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Certainly not. Since I have decided to 
participate, I shall give it my all. 
I will produce results worthy of the 
Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! That's the spirit! 
Give it everything you've got and become a 
stepping stone for my glorious victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, and just who are you talking to? 
You will soon regret ever inviting me.
